baseline_models.mechanism: The two intensive epithets form a control loop: repeated return restores orientation, while vigilant maintenance keeps that orientation from dissolving between returns.

activation_trace.role: Return to a place supplies the directional restoration in أَوَّاب.
Repeated bodily movement supplies recurrence rather than one completed turn.
Steady maintenance supplies continuity between successive returns.
Wakeful caution supplies detection of renewed drift.

changed_reading.before: A conventional label for a repentant, observant person.
changed_reading.after: A person repeatedly reorients and actively holds that orientation against renewed drift.

baseline_models.mechanism: The demonstrative presents an arrived object; the passive promise and distributive كُلّ assign it to every member of the qualified class at the promise's appointed encounter.

activation_trace.role: A promise that opens expectation supplies the prior speech now being fulfilled.
The appointed time or place supplies a rendezvous structure to هَٰذَا.
Comprehensive inclusion makes the line a distributive allocation, not praise of one exemplar.

changed_reading.before: A general assurance that the pious receive a reward.
changed_reading.after: A promised object has reached its appointment and is being assigned to every person matching the paired traits.

context_deltas.mechanism: The disputed return is called distant, but immediately before the focus the Garden is moved near and declared not distant. أَوَّاب therefore joins practiced reorientation to an eschatological return that has become arrival.

activation_trace.role: Return to a destination anchors the changed reading in أَوَّاب.
Return to a former state supplies the resurrection horizon that is disputed.
Distance from nearness marks the deniers' estimate of that return.
Movement into proximity reverses the earlier distance.
The explicit non-distant branch seals the reversal beside the focus.

structural_cues: 50:3 couples رَجْع with بَعِيد; 50:31 couples the Garden with nearness and غَيْرَ بَعِيد immediately before the focus.
The earlier ذَٰلِكَ presents a disputed return, while focus هَٰذَا presents fulfillment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the return/distance pair and its near/not-distant reversal; I infer that this spatial reversal also sharpens the recipient's أَوَّاب identity. Alternatively, the near/far language may concern resurrection and access only, without defining a spiritual habit.

changed_reading.before: أَوَّاب names repeated moral return in the abstract.
changed_reading.after: The returner's repeated orientation converges with the formerly denied return, now encountered as a near homecoming.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيبٍ anticipates the focus allocation, and the immediately following قَلْبٍ مُّنِيبٍ locates habitual return in the heart. The أَوَّاب-حَفِيظ pair becomes a maintained inward disposition of a servant, not intermittent repair alone.

activation_trace.role: Repeated return supplies the intensive motion being localized inwardly.
Ongoing maintenance turns recurrent motion into a stable disposition.
The repeated لِكُلِّ frame supplies a syntactic counterpart to the focus.
Humble obedience supplies the social posture of the returning person.
Habitual return makes مُنِيب a close functional neighbor of أَوَّاب.
The heart explicitly supplies the seat of that return.
The second habitual-return image immediately extends the focus recipient.

structural_cues: 50:8 and 50:32 repeat لِكُلِّ followed by a human descriptor.
50:33 follows without a new recipient and supplies the heart as مُنِيب.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two مُنِيب descriptions around the focus and a repeated لِكُلِّ frame; I infer that they mutually gloss the focus epithets. Alternatively, مُنِيب may be only an adjacent qualifying trait rather than a definition of أَوَّاب or حَفِيظ.

changed_reading.before: Return is a sequence of corrective acts.
changed_reading.after: Return is the heart's habitual obedient direction, continuously kept rather than repeatedly invented from nothing.

context_deltas.mechanism: A preserving Book retains what the earth removes, and a watcher guards every utterance. The human حَفِيظ is therefore moral custody within an already exhaustive system of custody: keeping oneself answers to being fully kept on record.

activation_trace.role: Guarding and tending anchor active custody in the focus epithet.
Wakefulness turns that custody toward self-monitoring.
The same guarding image makes the Book a preserving counterpart to the person.
Ordered writing supplies the durable record that custody protects.
Guarding surveillance extends preservation to each spoken word.

structural_cues: 50:4 opposes earthly diminishment to a حَفِيظ Book.
50:18 admits no utterance without a ready watcher.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated custody language around record and watcher; I infer a reciprocal relation between cosmic preservation and the recipient's self-keeping. Alternatively, focus حَفِيظ may simply mean observant of obligations, without deliberate mirroring of the record system.

changed_reading.before: حَفِيظ is privately observant or protective.
changed_reading.after: حَفِيظ actively guards orientation and speech while living inside a record in which no loss or utterance disappears.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated warning, the unalterable word, and opposed كُلّ allocations turn the focus into the favorable execution of one exact judgment economy: every soul arrives, every obstinate denier is assigned one destination, and every returning keeper another.

activation_trace.role: The good-promise branch supplies the favorable speech now realized.
Comprehensive distribution assigns that realization across the qualified class.
The threat branch supplies the adverse counterpart already advanced.
Denied alteration makes both outcomes executions of fixed prior speech.
Every soul supplies the universal population entering allocation.
Every obstinate denier supplies the opposed distributive class.
The closing warning branch keeps the adverse promise active beyond the garden scene.

structural_cues: The warning root recurs at 50:14, 50:20, 50:28, and 50:45, while 50:32 activates its good-promise branch.
50:21, 50:24, and 50:32 repeat كُلّ in a universal arrival followed by opposed trait-based allocations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the lexical promise/threat bifurcation, fixed speech, and parallel كُلّ formulas; I infer that the focus is the favorable side of the same sorting act. Alternatively, the warnings and promise may be separate speeches whose juxtaposition does not form one allocation formula.

changed_reading.before: The verse offers a generic beneficent promise.
changed_reading.after: The verse pronounces the favorable, trait-indexed outcome of an exact word whose warning side has also been executed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rare أوب images of returning with night and the sun reaching its setting place become active when the post-focus commands arrange worship before sunset, during night, and after prostration. أَوَّاب حَفِيظ can thus describe one who repeatedly returns through fixed temporal stations and preserves the cadence.

activation_trace.role: Returning with night supplies a rare temporal image within أَوَّاب.
The sun going to its setting place supplies cyclical return to an appointed station.
Maintained practice supplies the keeping of the temporal rhythm.
Worship by glorification supplies the repeated act occupying the stations.
Sunset directly activates the focus root's solar-return image.
Night directly activates the focus root's nocturnal-return image.
The repeated glorification command makes recurrence structural rather than incidental.
The end or aftermath of prostration supplies another recurring boundary station.

structural_cues: 50:39-40 repeat the worship command across before sunrise, before sunset, night, and the aftermath of prostration.
The sequence follows the focus closely enough to activate its nocturnal and solar أوب branches.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact night, sunset, recurrence, and maintenance images; I map the commanded schedule onto the recipient's intensive epithets. Alternatively, 50:39-40 may instruct the messenger independently and need not characterize the promised recipients.

changed_reading.before: أَوَّاب is mainly someone who returns after moral lapse.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, أَوَّاب حَفِيظ is one whose ordinary time repeatedly returns to worship and whose practice keeps that rhythm intact.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the form-distant split mapping of focus و ع د to ع د د rather than replacing the primary promise sense. It remains packet-anchored because the same mapped root and preparation branch recur under عَتِيد in 50:18 and 50:23. Downstream prose should present it only as a secondary readiness resonance: what was promised is already provisioned and held ready.

activation_trace.role: The primary promise branch constrains the reading to promised fulfillment.
The alternate preparation-of-provision branch adds an exploratory sense of prior readiness.
The shared preparation branch makes the watcher context a first image of something held ready.
The repeated shared branch makes the presented record a second image of prepared readiness.

changed_reading.before: The object has only been verbally foretold.
changed_reading.after: As a contained secondary resonance, the promised object is also already provisioned, present, and ready for disclosure.

strongest_changes: The allegedly distant return of 50:3 is reversed by the near, not-distant Garden of 50:31, making the returner's motion culminate in arrival.
The preserving Book and guarding watcher make human حَفِيظ reciprocal moral custody inside exhaustive preservation.
Repeated warning, fixed speech, and opposed كُلّ formulas recast the focus as the favorable half of an exact judgment allocation.
summary.what_was_special: The rare night-return and sunset branches of أوب align with the closing worship cadence, while the split ع د د mapping exposes a contained prepared-and-ready undertone shared with عَتِيد.
remaining_uncertainties: The near/far reversal may concern resurrection and access without deliberately defining spiritual return.
The sunset/night cadence and prepared/readiness resonance may be contextual analogies rather than intended lexical layers.
